# the paths that run .github/workflows/fuzz.yml (scripts/changed_paths.py decide)
# on.pull_request.paths of the workflow, when it has one, must list the same patterns in
# the same order (scripts/changed_paths.py sync)
# every file a job of the workflow executes or reads is listed: a missing one skips the
# job on a change that alters it
src/**
# fuzz/**: the targets and fuzz/Cargo.toml (fuzz/ is its own workspace root, so the root
# Cargo.lock is not read)
fuzz/**
# fuzz/Cargo.toml depends on the crate by `path = ".."`
Cargo.toml
# `cargo install cargo-fuzz` runs at the repository root, where this file picks the toolchain
rust-toolchain.toml
# the targets job lists the targets (and runs the lister's tests)
scripts/fuzz_targets.py
scripts/test_fuzz_targets.py
# the changes and gate jobs
scripts/changed_paths.py
.github/workflows/fuzz.yml
.github/paths/fuzz.txt
